description: Charter scope checkpoints, read by .claude/scripts/shared/lib/charter-scope.js and the commands that call it (#3001). Checks are conversational, never blocking: the user can expand scope, defer, proceed or revise. Formerly the always-on 04-charter-enforcement rule.

create-backlog.checks: the PRD each epic and story is created from

proposal.checks: the proposal title and problem statement

aligned.description: The work matches an in-scope or current-focus item, or (quick depth) matches no out-of-scope item

possibly-misaligned.description: The work matches no charter item, in scope or out; or it matches Out of Scope items but strictly more In Scope and Current Focus items (#3479)

conflicts.description: The work matches an out-of-scope item, and no more In Scope and Current Focus items than Out of Scope ones
conflicts.action: Flag the conflict and offer the resolution options

resolutionOptions.label: Expand charter scope
resolutionOptions.action: Follow expansionFlow, then continue with the original work

resolutionOptions.label: Defer to a future release
resolutionOptions.action: Note in the work item: "Deferred - out of current scope"

resolutionOptions.label: Proceed anyway
resolutionOptions.action: Log a scope-drift warning and continue

resolutionOptions.label: Revise the work item
resolutionOptions.action: Help the user change the work item to fit current scope

expansionFlow: Ask which scope item to add
Add it to the In Scope section of Inception/Scope-Boundaries.md with "Added <date> for <work item>"
Update the CHARTER.md In Scope section when the item is major

optOut.perSession: The user says to skip charter validation for this session; the command then does not call the helper
optOut.quietMode: The user asks for quiet validation: ask only on conflicts; possibly-misaligned is reported but not asked (helper flag --quiet)
